citation: S. Pathak et al., Acta Crystallographica C76 (2020), 1034–1042
title: Crystal structure of monoclinic hafnia (HfO2) revisited with synchrotron X-ray, neutron diffraction and first-principles calculations
model_note: Ideal stoichiometric model may set Hf occupancy to 1 explicitly; experimental refinement reported 0.9979(17). All sites have multiplicity 4; unit cell has 4 Hf and 8 O when idealized. This structure does not determine interstitial positions, migration paths or kinetic barriers.
